name: Peru
description: Peru from Caral and the Nazca to the Inca Empire, the Spanish conquest, independence and the modern republic.

checkpoints.name: Early Andes
checkpoints.note: Caral rose five thousand years ago. Chavín, the Nazca with their lines, the Moche and the Chimú followed.

checkpoints.name: The Incas
checkpoints.note: Pachacuti made Cusco the head of an empire that ran along the Andes, joined by roads, with Machu Picchu in the clouds.

checkpoints.name: Colony
checkpoints.note: Pizarro overthrew the Incas, and Lima became the capital of Spain's South America.

checkpoints.name: Republic
checkpoints.note: Peru declared independence in 1821. It lost wars, suffered the Shining Path, and saw many presidents fall.
